name: Macrohelp
author: CommanderTurtle
description: Floating Coordinates & Keymap visualizer for Omarsket macros. Macrohelp is an overlay and hook service for Omarsket macros in wayland; it provides pointer tools and an overlay client for the separately run controller. Press Alt+2 to get started. Control the mouse entirely with the keyboard, zero mouse needed. Build macros on the static web environment (no telemetry) at app.shel.sh/macro -- Complete with MCP & LLM Agent Skill Pack, so you're not the only one who can drive the mouse.

dependencies.name: wl-paste
dependencies.why: Clipboard input for optional Regedited append
